user.title: Shutter Pilot
user.description:
Shutter Pilot will be set up with three example areas. Location and sun times are taken from your Home Assistant settings automatically.

After setup, open **Shutter Pilot** in the sidebar to create your areas and assign your shutters.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Shutter Pilot is already set up. All areas and shutters are managed in the sidebar panel.

init.title: Shutter Pilot
init.description:
Everything is configured in the **Shutter Pilot** panel in the sidebar - areas, shutters, schedules and sun protection.

Currently configured: {area_count} areas, {shutter_count} shutters.

Just close this dialog and open the panel.

open_group.name: Open group
open_group.description: Opens all shutters of the given area. Without an area it applies to every area.

area_id.name: Area ID
area_id.description: Optional. ID of the area (e.g. living, sleep, children). Leave empty for every area.

close_group.name: Close group
close_group.description: Closes all shutters of the given area. Without an area it applies to every area.

area_id.name: Area ID
area_id.description: Optional. ID of the area (e.g. living, sleep, children). Leave empty for every area.

sun_protect_group.name: Sun protection group
sun_protect_group.description: Moves all shutters of the area to their sun protection position. Without an area it applies to every area.

area_id.name: Area ID
area_id.description: Optional. ID of the area (e.g. living, sleep, children). Leave empty for every area.

stop_group.name: Stop group
stop_group.description: Stops every moving shutter and awning of the given area. Without an area it applies to every area.

area_id.name: Area ID
area_id.description: Optional. ID of the area (e.g. living, sleep, children). Leave empty for every area.

ventilate_group.name: Ventilate group
ventilate_group.description: Moves all shutters of the area to their ventilation position. Without an area it applies to every area.

area_id.name: Area ID
area_id.description: Optional. ID of the area (e.g. living, sleep, children). Leave empty for every area.
